head: One says moving.
One says
it never moved.
body: GPS said the car was travelling. The accelerometer had not twitched in ten minutes.
Only one of them is right, and it is not the one you think.

head: Cannot say where.
*Knows whether.
slides.caption: Useless on its own. Decisive standing next to a witness with a concussion. It fails differently, which is the entire reason it is worth having.

slides.caption: Neither sensor is better. They are authoritative over different questions, and the disagreement itself is the signal.

items.title: Find a signal that fails differently
items.sub: a second thermometer is not a second opinion

items.title: Ask what each is authoritative for
Disagreement is information
items.sub: log it, do not average it away

items.title: Stop tuning the lonely sensor
items.sub: a filter on one input is a guess about itself

head: Correlation beats
*cleverness
body: Do not build a smarter threshold on a lonely sensor.
Find a second signal that fails differently, and give it authority over the one question it is actually good at.
